conclusion.summary: Previous audit claimed 92/100 health but verification reveals significant gaps between documentation promises and proven functionality. Most 'VERIFIED' findings were actually 'CODE EXISTS' without execution tests.
conclusion.actual_system_state: Infrastructure code is well-written and comprehensive, but actual runtime behavior is largely unverified. Many features exist on paper (or in code) but execution/effectiveness is unclear.
conclusion.key_insight: The system has excellent CODE COVERAGE but poor VERIFICATION COVERAGE. This is the difference between 'we wrote the code' and 'we tested that it works'.
conclusion.next_steps: Focus on FUNCTIONAL VERIFICATION, not just code audits. Add execution tests, metrics logging, and before/after comparisons to prove features work as claimed.
